parameters: Here we stand at Mount Ptolomea, gateway to the heavens.\! Tell me, scholar, why do you serve the Zanatus cult?
T-to serve the true god, of course.\! To expose the lies of the Donari, to bring balance to this world...
Spare me the flowery words, scholar.\! We all have a price.\! You have been promised great rewards.
The Grandmaster has already made me powerful.\! Have you questioned why you are still as you always were?
...\| Y-you were already a great warrior...\| The Grandmaster sought to make you his champion.\! The weapon and the will of Zanatus before he returns to this world.
A-And my gift is far different!
The language of the ancient Donari.\! Has anyone else commited their lives to the mastery of it, as you have?
W-what is the point of your questions?!

You killed the only other one. Oxley.\! No one could interpret the texts without decades of study.\! Yet the Grandmaster possesses knowledge even you do not have.\! Why do you think that is, Jebediah?
Y-you will not shake my resolve, Hand of Zanatus...\| The true god knows all and sees all!

I hope for your sake that someday you learn that only you can control your destiny.\! The Nephilim Army is winning the war, and they will be at Casamir's doorstep in a matter of weeks.\! Soon, we will all have to make a choice.
